plugins.pageDescription: Integrate "skill + web console" plugins (e.g. dashi-ppt, vibe-motion): once configured, a shortcut button in the workspace right sidebar inserts a hook into the session composer; the agent starts the plugin's web console and VibeX opens it in the Web Preview once reachable.
plugins.sectionDescription: Built-in plugins start disabled; enabling one counts as configuring it (node/npx are checked and the skill installs globally; a failure never blocks enabling). Only enabled plugins appear in the workspace sidebar.
plugins.name: Plugin name
plugins.installCommandHint: Runs globally after saving; skills CLI commands (npx skills add …) get -y appended automatically.
plugins.consoleCommand: Web console start command (given to the agent)
plugins.consoleHint: VibeX never runs this command — it is handed to the agent via the hook together with the port and URL, and the agent starts the console. Command, URL and hook all support the {{port}} placeholder (a free port is allocated on click). With a console URL configured, the Web Preview opens automatically once the service is reachable.
plugins.hookMessageHint: Placeholders: {{pluginName}}, {{skillName}}, {{consoleCommand}}, {{consoleUrl}}, {{port}}. Rendered into the session composer when the plugin button is clicked; you decide when to send.
plugins.defaultHookMessage: You are currently working with the "{{skillName}}" skill. Read the skill's instructions first, then start its web console (reference command: {{consoleCommand}}); the agreed console address is {{consoleUrl}}. If the service is not up or unreachable at that address, inspect its logs or restart it yourself. Once the console is ready, work together with it and me.
plugins.author: Author (optional)
plugins.iconTooLarge: Icon image is too large (200KB max).
plugins.saveHint: After saving, node/npx are checked and the skill install command runs in the background.
plugins.requiredFieldsMissing: Plugin name, skill name, console command, hook message and install command are all required.
plugins.installFailed: Skill install for "{{name}}" failed. Run `{{command}}` yourself or ask the agent to install it. {{error}}
plugins.empty: No plugins yet. Click "New plugin" to integrate your first skill + web console plugin.
plugins.manifestImported: vibex-plugin.json loaded — review the form and save.
plugins.devKitDownloadFailed: Failed to download the dev kit: {{error}}
plugins.enableTooltip: Enabled plugins appear in the workspace sidebar (first enable installs the skill)
plugins.pageDescriptionV2: Manage plugin membership and enablement separately from tool, skill, and provider readiness.
plugins.sectionDescriptionV2: VibeX installs manifest-declared dependencies using pinned versions and hashes. Arbitrary install commands are not accepted here.
plugins.emptyV2: No Plugin v2 manifest is available.
plugins.legacyDescription: Legacy manifests are retained as migration evidence only. VibeX never executes their install_command.
plugins.migrationRequired: Migration to a safe Plugin v2 manifest is required. The legacy install command will not run.
